description: Post-typesetting measurement of continuation tails. For every chain cut before a non-final member, and for every cross-column or cross-page pair of adjacent body elements in an article's reading order whether or not a chain covered it, this pass measures the finished last line of the paragraph handing over: how many ink characters it holds, how far its ink runs against the paragraph's set width, and whether it stops on sentence-ending punctuation (read with the same terminal vocabulary chain detection declares). The report is the only measurement of rendered column tails; the chain simulation's own cut accounting is process information, not evidence. full_line_fill_min says how full a last line must run to count as a full line in the summary; short_tail_max_chars says how few characters make a dangling tail worth listing one by one. This pass moves nothing and writes only its sidecar.
